$comment: item/citation-addresses-rot (issue #371). Every `path:line` citation appearing in an items[].doneWhen is declared here, and .github/scripts/assert-ledger-citations.py refuses one that is not. Scope is items[].doneWhen ONLY, per decision/0132: an item's doneWhen is read for what to do now, so a rotted address in one is a defect, while a Decision's rationale is read for what was true then, so repointing one would replace a correct dated observation with a wrong one. A full path is recorded per entry because the citation text is not resolvable on its own -- `Controller.php` matches two files in this tree -- and because Python's glob skips dot-directories, which reported .github/ paths as not found three separate times in this project. PREFER NOT TO ADD AN ENTRY: name an anchor that moves with the thing (a function, a job, a heading, a quoted fragment) and no entry is needed at all.
$bareComment: A RATCHET, not a rule against bare line numbers. item/citation-addresses-rot's audit found none of these is a live address -- most sit in Completed items describing the state the item changed, the rest are quotational -- so declaring each would catch nothing that exists today. Grandfathering them costs nothing and still refuses the next one. Raise a pin only with a reason in the commit; lower it when prose is removed, so no spare slot is left open.
